title: Select map object type (Robot/Container/Cell/Charger) before clicking on Map Monitor
summary: Use the Map Monitor Quick Select panel to choose the correct selectable object type (Robot, Container, Cell, Charger) before clicking items on the map, so the inspection click is interpreted as the intended object type.
when_to_use: When you need to inspect a specific object on the Map Monitor map (Robot vs Container vs Cell vs Charger) and the map contains multiple object types.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Select the intended Quick Select object type on the Map Monitor left-side panel before clicking the map item for inspection.
access_or_tools_needed: Left-side Quick Select panel icons for object selection: Robot Selection, Container Selection, Cell Selection, Charger Selection

system_preconditions: Map Monitor is available in the RMS application.

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the left-side icons for selecting Robot, Container, Cell, and Charger before clicking map items.

steps.title: Open Map Monitor and locate the left-side Quick Select panel
steps.purpose: Ensure you are on the Map Monitor screen where map items are clickable and where you can select the object type to inspect.
steps.instruction: Open the Map Monitor screen in the RMS application and locate the left-side Quick Select panel.
steps.expected_result: The left-side Quick Select panel with object selection icons (Robot, Container, Cell, Charger) is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Quick Select icons on the left side of the Map Monitor screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot see the Quick Select icons (object selection panel not visible), or you are attempting to click map items without selecting an object type.

actions.label: Open Map Monitor
actions.exact_action: Select Map Monitor from the RMS navigation menu (as shown in the RMS context).

steps.title: Choose the intended object type in Quick Select (Robot/Container/Cell/Charger)
steps.purpose: Set the selection mode so that the next click on the map is interpreted as the correct object type for inspection.
steps.instruction: In the Quick Select panel, click the icon that matches the object type you want to inspect: Robot, Container, Cell, or Charger.
steps.expected_result: The Quick Select mode is set to the intended object type (Robot vs Container vs Cell vs Charger) before you click the map.
steps.healthy_condition: You have selected the correct Quick Select icon corresponding to the object type you intend to inspect.
steps.failure_condition: You click a map item without first selecting the intended object type in the Quick Select panel.

actions.label: Select object type icon
actions.exact_action: Click the corresponding Quick Select icon: Robot, Container, Cell, or Charger.

steps.title: Click the desired object on the map to inspect it
steps.purpose: Perform the inspection click using the previously selected object type.
steps.instruction: After selecting the object type in Quick Select, click the desired object on the map.
steps.expected_result: The map click is interpreted as the selected object type (Robot vs Container vs Cell vs Charger) for inspection.
steps.healthy_condition: The inspection results correspond to the object type you selected in Quick Select.
steps.failure_condition: Inspection results do not match the intended object type (e.g., you intended Robot but the click is interpreted as a different object type).

actions.label: Click map object
actions.exact_action: Click the desired object on the map after selecting the object type in the left-side Quick Select panel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If inspection results do not match the intended object type, stop and re-select the intended object type in Quick Select before clicking again.

steps.title: If you clicked without selecting the correct object type, re-select and click again
steps.purpose: Correct a misinterpreted map click by restoring the correct selection mode before re-clicking.
steps.instruction: If you clicked on the map without selecting the correct object type first, stop. Re-select the intended object type in the Quick Select panel, then click the intended object on the map again.
steps.expected_result: After re-selection, the next map click is interpreted as the intended object type for inspection.
steps.healthy_condition: Inspection results align with the intended object type after re-selecting the correct Quick Select icon.
steps.failure_condition: You continue clicking map items without re-selecting the intended object type, resulting in repeated mismatches.

actions.label: Re-select intended object type
actions.exact_action: Click the correct Quick Select icon (Robot/Container/Cell/Charger) before clicking the map item.

actions.label: Re-click the intended map object
actions.exact_action: Click the intended object on the map after selecting the correct object type.

success_criteria: You select the intended Quick Select icon (Robot/Container/Cell/Charger) before clicking the map item.
The inspection click is interpreted as the intended object type.
healthy_conditions: Quick Select panel icons for Robot, Container, Cell, and Charger are visible on the left side of Map Monitor.
Inspection results correspond to the object type selected in Quick Select.
failure_conditions: Map click is interpreted as the wrong object type because the correct Quick Select icon was not selected first.
Repeated mismatches occur because the operator continues clicking without re-selecting the intended object type.

screens_or_images.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel icons (Robot Selection, Cell Selection, Charger Selection, Container Selection) used to choose the object type before clicking map items.

missing_details: The packet does not provide explicit UI labels for the selected-state indicator (e.g., whether the selected icon highlights or shows a specific text).
